instruction: Get a login password for Amazon ECR and authenticate Docker
output: aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com

instruction: Create an Amazon ECR repository
Describe all ECR repositories in the account
List images in an ECR repository
Batch delete images from ECR by image ID
output: aws ecr batch-delete-image --repository-name myapp --image-ids imageTag=old-version --region us-east-1

instruction: Delete all untagged images from ECR
output: aws ecr list-images --repository-name myapp --filter tagStatus=UNTAGGED --query 'imageIds[*]' --region us-east-1 | aws ecr batch-delete-image --repository-name myapp --image-ids file:///dev/stdin --region us-east-1

instruction: Put a lifecycle policy on an ECR repository
output: aws ecr put-lifecycle-policy --repository-name myapp --lifecycle-policy-text '{"rules":[{"rulePriority":1,"description":"Expire old images","selection":{"tagStatus":"any","countType":"imageCountMoreThan","countNumber":100},"action":{"type":"expire"}}]}' --region us-east-1

instruction: Get the lifecycle policy from an ECR repository
Tag an ECR image with a specific tag
output: aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name myapp --image-ids imageTag=latest --region us-east-1 | aws ecr put-image --repository-name myapp --image-tag stable --image-manifest file:///dev/stdin --region us-east-1

instruction: Set ECR repository image scanning on push
output: aws ecr put-image-scanning-configuration --repository-name myapp --image-scanning-configuration scanOnPush=true --region us-east-1

instruction: Get ECR repository policy
Set ECR cross-account repository policy
Describe ECR image scan findings
output: aws ecr describe-image-scan-findings --repository-name myapp --image-id imageTag=1.0 --region us-east-1

instruction: Start an ECR image scan
output: aws ecr start-image-scan --repository-name myapp --image-id imageTag=1.0 --region us-east-1

instruction: Create an ECR repository with encryption
output: aws ecr create-repository --repository-name myapp --encryption-configuration encryptionType=AES256 --region us-east-1

instruction: Tag an ECR repository
List tags on an ECR repository
Create a public ECR repository
Describe ECR public repositories
Get ECR authorization token
Complete an ECR layer upload
output: aws ecr complete-layer-upload --repository-name myapp --upload-id 123456 --layer-digest sha256:abc123 --region us-east-1

instruction: Initiate a multi-part layer upload to ECR
Delete an ECR repository (force)
Upload a layer part to ECR
output: aws ecr upload-layer-part --repository-name myapp --upload-id 123456 --part-first-byte 0 --part-last-byte 1048575 --layer-part-blob fileb://layer.tar --region us-east-1
